# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 10 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Greek MS | **Section:** The Man of God Speaks to Aseneth; She Is Transformed

---

**10:1** And the man of God said to her: 'Be of good courage, Aseneth, and do not be afraid, but stand upright and I will speak to you.'

**10:2** And Aseneth stood on her feet, and the man of God said to her: 'Remove the black garment of mourning from you and shake the ashes from your head, and wash your face and your hands with pure living water, and put on a new garment, an undefiled and white garment, and gird yourself with a bright and shining girdle of virginity.'

**10:3** 'And come back to me and I will tell you words of life.'

**10:4** And Aseneth hurried into her inner chamber and put on a white new linen garment, and tied a golden girdle about herself, and wrapped a gold linen head-cloth on her head, and came to the man of God.

**10:5** And the man of God said to her: 'Now remove the covering from your head, for today you are a pure virgin and your head is like that of a young man.'

**10:6** And Aseneth removed the head-cloth from her head.

**10:7** And the man of God said to her: 'Be of good courage, Aseneth, for behold, the Lord God heard the voice of your confession, and has seen the affliction of your heart, for you were humiliated before him and submitted yourself under the great wings of the Most High God.'

**10:8** 'And behold, your name is written in the book of the living in the heavens, and it will not be blotted out for ever and ever.'

**10:9** 'From today you will be renewed and formed anew and made alive again, and you shall eat the bread of blessing and drink the cup of immortality and be anointed with the ointment of incorruption.'

**10:10** 'Be of good courage, Aseneth, behold, I will give you as a bride to Joseph today, and your name shall no more be called Aseneth but your name shall be City-of-Refuge, for many nations will take refuge in you and under your wings many peoples trusting in the Lord God, the Most High, will be sheltered.'

**10:11** And Aseneth rejoiced greatly at the words of the man of God and fell at his feet and said: 'Lord, have mercy on me your handmaid, for I was speaking evil and did not know that Joseph is your son.'

**10:12** And the man of God said to her: 'Joseph is a son of God and a son of the power of God, and this is the mystery of the Most High God. I cannot speak more of this mystery to you.'

**10:13** And the man of God said to Aseneth: 'Have you heard the word of my mouth?'

**10:14** And she said: 'Yes, lord, I have heard all the words of your mouth.'

**10:15** And the man said to her: 'From now on you will eat the blessed bread of life, and drink the cup of immortality, and be anointed with the ointment of incorruption, for behold, from today your youth will not grow old, and your beauty will not fade, but you will be like a walled city fortified in all eternity.'

**10:16** And Aseneth said to the man of God: 'Lord, sit down for a little while, and I will set before you a table and bread, and you shall eat, and I will bring for you old and good wine with a pleasant fragrance, and you shall drink, and then you shall go on your way.'

**10:17** And the man said to her: 'Bring also a honeycomb.' And Aseneth stopped, because there was no honeycomb in her storeroom.

**10:18** And the man of God said: 'Go in to your inner chamber and you will find a honeycomb.' And Aseneth went in and found a honeycomb lying on the table, large and white as snow and full of honey, and its fragrance was like the breath of life.

---
*EMET: hyphenated compounds; chapter:verse format.*
